mapper.select: SELECT * FROM oa_consumable WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND quantity <= low_stock_threshold AND warn_enabled = 1 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY quantity ASC
SELECT * FROM oa_consumable WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND consumable_id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 FOR UPDATE

SELECT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM biz_purchase_item WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND consumable_id = #{id})) + (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_consumable_ledger WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND consumable_id = #{id})) + (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM oa_consumable_request_item WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND consumable_id = #{id}))

SELECT CAST(dict_code AS CHAR) AS category_id, dict_label AS label, dict_value AS value FROM sys_dict_data WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dict_type = 'oa_consumable_category' AND status = '0' ORDER BY dict_sort, dict_code
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_dict_data WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND dict_type = 'oa_consumable_category' AND status = '0' AND dict_code = #{id}

SELECT CAST(consumable_id AS CHAR) AS consumable_id, name, model, unit, quantity, CAST(category_id AS CHAR) AS category_id FROM oa_consumable WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE'
AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%') OR model LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.keyword}, '%'))
AND category_id = #{query.categoryId} ORDER BY name, consumable_id
SELECT consumable_id FROM oa_consumable WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND consumable_id > #{afterId} ORDER BY consumable_id LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE oa_risk_alert SET risk_status = 'CLOSED', handled_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, handle_remark = '耗材库存已恢复至预警阈值之上', update_by = 'system', update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND business_type = 'CONSUMABLE' AND business_id = #{id} AND risk_code = 'CONSUMABLE_LOW_STOCK' AND risk_status IN ('OPEN', 'HANDLING', 'IGNORED')
